steps.content: The impound deadline is fast approaching. You try to halt Ninety-Nine's mutation with the shackles every day, but to little effect.

steps.speaker: FAC researcher
steps.content: Chief, Ninety-Nine's mutations have exceeded the critical threshold, and her limbs are 60% corrupted.

steps.speaker: FAC researcher
steps.content: This means she is beyond help... and extremely dangerous.

steps.speaker: FAC researcher
steps.content: In light of these circumstances, the FAC is strictly forbidding you from accessing to or shackling Ninety-Nine from now on.

steps.speaker: FAC researcher
steps.content: We don't want to lose our Chief over a Sinner.
...Don't worry, I won't go anymore.
The FAC investigator gestures for you to leave Ninety-Nine's cell.
You think for a moment, and decide not to confront the man sent by your superiors but look for a "companion" that can help you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What do you mean?

options: Do you want to go see Ninety-Nine?

choices.text: Do you want to go see Ninety-Nine?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Would you be so kind? I don't believe at all!
Shalom
test
test
test
test
test
test
She is in critical condition now, but you were the one who brought her out of the Laboratory of Parma.
So I'm willing to take the risk and let you meet her.
Please, Hella.
Hella sees the files in your hand and immediately rushes to the door.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why didn't you tell me earlier!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: How is she now?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh, never mind. You never have anything good to say! I want to see for myself! Take me to her!
The cell door opens, and you personally escort Hella towards Ninety-Nine's cell.
Hella rushes down the hall. You've wanted to ask about Ninety-Nine's conditions, but you stop after Hella shot you a scornful look.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I knew you would try this.
Nightingale blocks your path.
Nightingale, I want to give it a shot.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Sigh...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Go. I'll be on the lookout.
Thank you.
As you pass Nightingale, you place a tiny machine on Hella in front of your adjutant.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ninety-Nine!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why did you tie her up?!
You open the cell door, and Hella rushes to Ninety-Nine. Seeing the heavy chains and high-fiber straps constraining Ninety-Nine, Hella starts to question you furiously.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ninety-Nine... don't be afraid! I'm here now! You'll be alright... I'll tell them to remove these damn chains right now!
All the restraints are custom-made. Even though everyone locked up here are designated S-class threats...
...we are trying our best to mitigate the contamination of her.

As an important figure, according to the FAC, you are prohibited from entering the room with Hella for your own safety. You have no choice but to monitor the situation from the door, ready to communicate with them at any time.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: She looks so painful! You! Release her immediately! I'm taking her away with me!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Hella, I'm alright.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: How can you be alright?!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You look even more disheveled than when I first met you!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Weren't you as disheveled back then?

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Back then... we were always confined in a dark room like this.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: We couldn't see a thing...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: ...Who are you?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: They said they would keep me next to a monster. Are you the monster?

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Perhaps.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But you look so adorable. How can you be a monster?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Are you just going to let them trap you here forever and fight for their amusement?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: This laboratory has nothing! We can't even see the sun, the moon or the stars! It's terrible!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: What is... the sun?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh? You've never seen it before? Were you born in the laboratory?

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Perhaps. So what is the sun?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The sun is a big, golden ball that gives off the heat! No human can live without it!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: But I've never seen the sun, and I'm alive.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I understand. I'm not a human.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hahahaha! Yes, you're not a human! You're a cute little monster!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Then... do you want to go outside with me to see the sun?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Even if you're a monster, you should be a free monster!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Is this... the outside world?!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: So the wind isn't bitter at all!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: And people... they don't all wear white coats!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hehe, there are many things you don't know about the outside world. Follow me and learn, okay?

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Yes, I will follow Hella closely.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Hella, watch out!
Ninety-Nine pulled Hella behind her and reared her fangs at the robot in front of them.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Don't even think about hurting Hella!
The innocent robot was only trying to pick up the trash by Hella's feet, but Ninety-Nine thought it was trying to attack.
She attacked the robot without hesitation...

steps.speaker: Alarm
steps.content: Beep beep beep... vandalism against the city sanitation system detected...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Good heavens, what are you doing? We just escaped! I don't want to be thrown back in jail!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Hella? Hella, where should we go?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Run!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Haha... you were like a dumb-dumb back then.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: You also said... in the outside world... even trees could deceive you... for example, golden fruits are very sour…

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What... you really believed that? So that's why you never eat mangos or oranges!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: But... the outside world was just as amazing as you said it would be, filled with sunshine.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Following you, I became a free monster...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: You gave me the yearning for freedom.
Infection-induced black lines streak across Ninety-Nine's face. She tries her best to speak clearly and restrain her desire to kill.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: And you let me... escape from Parma... from the beast inside me...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I can still do that! You see, I took you out of Parma. I can take you out of the Bureau the same way!
Hella glares at you, her eyes brimming with tears.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It's just a bureau chief! I can kill him right now!
steps.female_content: It's just a bureau chief! I can kill her right now!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: If you really wanted to kill him...
steps.female_content: If you really wanted to kill her...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: You... wouldn't have stopped me back then.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: He's important to you.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I know he's kind, and I understand... his good intentions...
steps.female_content: I know she's kind, and I understand... her good intentions...

steps.content: The cell was heating up. This meant that Ninety-Nine was about to go manic.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: It's time... to give up.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Hella...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Give up? Even the Chief hasn't given up on you yet!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ninety-Nine, why are you saying this?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: How can I ever give up on you? Ninety-Nine, you idiot!
The custom-made restraints can no longer control the Ninety-Nine in mania. The temperature in the cell is rising rapidly. Hella falls back, scalded by the sudden heatwave.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Go... go away...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ninety-Nine... Ninety-Nine, you ****!!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Hella... ahhhhh—!
Ninety-Nine's eyes were bloodshot, and her ability to reason evaporated with the heat.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I f**ing broke you out of the hell last time! I can save you again! Don't you believe me?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't think you can get rid of me! I'm gonna be by your f**ing side forever!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Ahhhhh—!
Hella! Watch out!
Ninety-Nine goes manic and starts throwing whatever she can get her hands on at Hella.
Tears mixed with blood flow down Hella's cheeks as the sharp debris scraps past her face.
Hella tries to hold out, but a figure blocks her vision.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why... why did you come in?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Get lost! I'll save Ninety-Nine on my own!
If you keep this up, you'll both die!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Roarrrr—
Ninety-Nine broke free from your shackles. The violent backlash made you dizzy.
Blegh...
The pain and nausea of the backlash made you feel as if all your internal organs were twisted together. You vomited violently.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You... how did you...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ninety-Nine! If you... if you keep this up, I'm going to hit you!
By now, Ninety-Nine is unable to listen to anything, even the screams of the one she cares most dearly.
You struggle to get up, press the emergency button you've brought with you, and rush towards Hella.
You seize Hella by the collar and drag her towards the door. Unable to break free, Hella starts to punch you non-stop.
If this makes you feel better, then so be it.
But Hella, I hope you know that I will not give up on her.
Three days later...
Has Hella... finally calmed down?
You sighed as you surveyed the messy office.
The day Ninety-Nine went manic, the FAC issued an official transfer notice and took her away.
After hearing about that, Hella ignored her wounds and threw tantrums from your infirmary all the way to the managers' offices.
Today was the first day where an angry Hella didn't appear in your office.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Hella? Since last night, she has accepted six missions she had previously rejected.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Perhaps... she wants to keep herself busy.
...I didn't protect Ninety-Nine properly.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You already tried your best. At this point, we really have no way of shackling Sinners with this degree of contamination.
That's my problem, then.
I'm... not strong enough.
If my shackles were stronger... Ninety-Nine wouldn't have been taken away...
2 hours later...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, we just received news that we've lost control of Hella. She fled the mission area.
What?!
You looked at Hella's coordinates and suddenly realized something.
See if she's on the road where Ninety-Nine's transport vehicle is!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Yes sir... and Chief, the timing of her escape is too perfect to be a coincidence. It seems like she planned it after learning about our plans.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Remember the tapping device you put on her?
Startled, you quickly felt your pocket and found the tapping device put on Hella.
Could it be when you were dragging her away from Ninety-Nine...
None of this matters now. She's aiming to free Ninety-Nine. If Ninety-Nine is released now, Hella will die in her hands!
Nightingale, we must depart immediately!
